content.title: How to watch Guardians vs. Dodgers: TV channel and streaming options for April 1
content.text: The Los Angeles Dodgers host the Cleveland Guardians at 8:20 p.m. ET on Wednesday, with both teams hoping to win the series. Yoshinobu Yamamoto (1-0, 3.00 ERA) will start for the Dodgers, who are 4-1 this season and first in the NL West. Gavin Williams (0-1, 5.40 ERA) is starting for the Guardians, who are 3-3 and first in the AL Central.How to watch Cleveland Guardians vs. Los Angeles Dodgers Venue: Dodger Stadium Time: 8:20 p.m. ET Streaming: Fubo (Stream now) TV: SportsNet LA and CleGuardians.TV Watching in person?
